maddeler.e:
يقتصروا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَصِرُوا (yaqtaṣirū) /jaq.ta.sˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# يُقْتَصَرُوا (yuqtaṣarū) /juq.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
